evals.prompt: 生命周期检查发现这个 GitHub 仓库直接从根目录发布 npm 包，请按默认策略拆分 README，并验证发包内容；只做本地修改。
evals.expected_output: Moves the complete root documentation to .github/README.md, fixes links relative to its new location, creates a minimal absolute-link root README, inspects the real package tarball to confirm only the minimal README is published, and makes no commit, push, or publication.

evals.prompt: 这是 GitHub monorepo，根 README 是整个产品说明，npm 包从 packages/core 发布。让 npm 页面只显示一个指向仓库文档的短 README。
evals.expected_output: Preserves the repository root README, creates or updates the compact README in packages/core, derives an absolute GitHub link from repository metadata, and validates the packages/core tarball rather than the repository root.

evals.prompt: 这个 npm 包托管在 GitLab，而且我们明确要 npm 与仓库共用完整 README。检查一下是否需要套用 .github/README.md 方案。
evals.expected_output: Does not apply the GitHub-specific layout, preserves the explicit shared-README decision, and explains that a dedicated publish-directory fallback is only needed if the user later chooses separate registry documentation.
